subject: Requesting trial extension while PO routes - Medivex pilot
messages:
From: Sam Tully <sam.tully@medivex.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medivex.com>
Date: 2025-07-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial access - PO routing delay

Hi Hannah,

Quick note from procurement — our legal and finance teams are routing the PO for the pilot but it looks like sign-off will slip into next week. We really want to keep the sandbox live for our data science team while that happens.

Can Redwood extend the trial window or provision a short token credit so we don’t lose momentum? I attached the draft PO so you can see where it is in the flow.

Attaching: medivex_po_draft_20250712.pdf

Thanks,
Sam Tully
Head of Data Science, Medivex
Sam.Tully@medivex.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Tully <sam.tully@medivex.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-13T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial access - PO routing delay

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft.

Short answer: yes — we can keep the environment active while your PO completes. Two options that work on our side:

- A 14-calendar-day extension to the trial window tied to your existing sandbox (no extra billing action).
- Or a temporary credits package (we typically provision a token top-up) to keep CI/CD tests and large-batch runs moving; we can set this as a one-time 3,000 inference-credit grant.

I’m looping in finance (Ben) and my manager (Marissa) to confirm which option to formalize and to record in HubSpot. If you prefer credits, please confirm that 3,000 tokens will cover the next week of runs, otherwise tell me the target.

If acceptable I’ll add an internal note with the deal id and approve the hold for billing.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2025-07-13T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial access - PO routing delay

Hannah / Marissa — reviewed the PO draft and the customer history. Finance is OK with a short-term operational credit to preserve proof-of-concept momentum.

I approve a one-time grant of up to 3,000 inference credits to Medivex, valid for 10 days from the time we provision them. Conditions:
- Attach a HubSpot note with the deal id (RDW-3749) and the reason (procurement routing delay).
- Create a billing hold entry so no charges are processed while PO is pending.
- Finance will record the credit as promotional and reconcile against the signed PO later.

I attached a short internal approval note.

Attaching: finance_approval_note.txt

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Date: 2025-07-14T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial access - PO routing delay

Sam — heard back from finance; we’ll provision a 3,000-credit top-up and place a billing hold for the duration of the PO routing. Hannah, can you do the provisioning today and drop the HubSpot note (RDW-3749)? Ben, confirm when you’ve made the reconciliation entry so I can close the loop on my side.

Sam — you should see the credits appear in your account within the next two hours. If you need more runway, tell us the expected weekly token consumption and we’ll evaluate further.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Marissa / Hannah — this is perfect, thank you. 3,000 credits for 10 days should cover the immediate runs. We’ll aim to complete internal approvals by next Wednesday. I’ll drop a note to procurement to prioritize the PO.

Appreciate the quick support and the billing hold — keeps our team productive.

Sam
